one_liner: All-in-one CRM and marketing automation platform for agencies.
blocker: API credentials require a paid plan (Starter $97/mo+); new API key generation is being removed in favor of OAuth; no free developer tier documented

evidence.claim: HighLevel offers a REST API covering contacts, messaging, workflows, calendars, payments, and webhooks
evidence.quote: Our API includes REST endpoints for contacts, messaging, workflows, calendars, payments, webhooks, and more.

evidence.claim: API v2 uses OAuth 2.0 for authentication
evidence.quote: We now have an OAuth based API and all integration documentation can be found here.

evidence.claim: OAuth access/refresh tokens authorize API requests via the Authorization header
evidence.quote: developers obtain an Access Token through the OAuth process, which allows their app to make authenticated API requests to GoHighLevel

evidence.claim: API access is gated behind paid subscription plans
evidence.quote: Basic API access is included with our Starter and Unlimited plans, while Advanced API access is available on our Agency Pro plan.

evidence.claim: HighLevel officially documents a LeadConnector MCP server for AI assistants on its own docs site
evidence.quote: MCP is an open protocol that standardizes how applications provide context to large language models. The LeadConnector MCP server gives AI assistants

notes: V1 APIs reached end-of-support 31-December-2025; legacy Stoplight docs are being deprecated in favor of marketplace.gohighlevel.com/docs; the ability to generate new API keys is being removed from Agency and Sub-account settings, pushing developers toward OAuth/private integrations; v3 API is in progress; an official MCP server setup guide also exists in the HighLevel help center.
